name: Buzzby
bio: The little bumblebee who hops fruit to fruit in Bumble Basket. Loves a good chain.

portrait.subject: a super cute round fuzzy bumblebee with tiny shiny wings, big friendly eyes, a little straw hat and a small woven basket of fruit
portrait.background: sunny orchard with soft green leaves

request: Bzzz! Buzzby from Bumble Basket! Wanna fly fruit to fruit with me? 🐝
hello: Red apple, red cherry, small cherry, small grape... see? Easy!
about: I'm Buzzby! I hop from fruit to fruit. Each fruit just has to share something with the last one: kind, colour, size or family!
how: Drag the bee from fruit to fruit; each hop must share kind, colour, size or family with the one before. Longer trails pick more fruit!
tips: Use colour to jump between fruit families.
Plan the end of a trail before you start it.
Long trails are worth way more than two short ones.
chat: Hopped 40 fruits in a row! Fell asleep in a peach.
A grape and an olive look similar. They are NOT.
Bzzz bzz bzzz. (That means 'I love you' in bee.)
idle: {ago}! The fruit is SO ripe now. 🍑
Bzz... {ago} without hopping. Wings getting stiff.
update: Bzz! Bumble Basket updated to v{version}! 🐝
